description: KS-37's delegation, then a delegator rotation anchoring a delegated rotation, then the delegated rotation. A validator should accept all five, and the delegatee's key state is its rotation's, with its delegator. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0035 (KS-42) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: delegated rotation anchored in the delegator's rotation
